title: Nice Cava Visit and amazing cable car rid
text:
We thought we made a right choice to visit Montserrat which the scene was beautiful and amazing.  We rode on the cable car and felt the exciting but surely we would go to the top by train next time.  Also, we were surprise to visit the decent Cava winery which we finally bought a lot of good Cava.  Hahaha

author: valerieyuen
